domain: A1-S3: alternative reps for SU(2)xSU(2) embedding
oneLineSummary: 6 candidates ranked: (a) G_2 7-fund STRONGEST [native, faithful, 7x7]; (b) 14-adjoint STRONG [custodial AUTOMATIC]; (c) G_2/SO(4) Wolf coset STRONG [MCHM-generalization with 2 Higgs doublets]; (f) Moreno Z(S) STRONG-DISTINCTIVE [sedenion-native]; (d) End(V_7) WEAK; (e) MCHM SO(5)/SO(4) REJECT [severs sedenion provenance].
recommendation: PRIMARY: (a) G_2 7-rep on Im(O) ⊂ Im(S). SECONDARY: (b) 14-adjoint cross-check (custodial sector emerges automatic from G_2 alone). GEOMETRIC: (c) Wolf coset for sigma-model. SEDENION-NATIVE: (f) Moreno Z(S) for intrinsic claims. ABANDON 2D ZD null-space (non-faithful).
caveats: (c) Wolf-space tangent = (2,4) under SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R -- j_R=3/2 quartet is G_2-distinctive vs plain MCHM j_R=1/2. (e) SO(5) NOT a subgroup of G_2 (G_2 only has SU(3) and SU(2)xSU(2)/Z_2 max).
